title: Revocation by change of circumstances.
bodyText: Except as provided in sections 560:2-803 and 560:2-804, a change of circumstances does not revoke a will or any part of it.
bodyHtml: §560:2-508  Revocation by change of circumstances.  Except as provided in sections 560:2-803 and 560:2-804, a change of circumstances does not revoke a will or any part of it. [L 1996, c 288, pt of §1]
